summary: Cleanup-and-reset routine. Reads the pointer at this+0x4; if it is non-null, invokes its callback at offset 0x28 (a cdecl function pointer) passing this as the argument, and keeps the callback's return value as the function result. Regardless of the guard outcome, clears both this+0x4 and this+0x10 to 0. Returns the callback return value when the sub-object was present, otherwise 0.

local_names.this: receiver object; this+0x4 holds a pointer to a sub-object with a cleanup callback, this+0x10 is a state field
local_names.result: entry value of this+0x4 if null, otherwise the callback's return value

operations.description: Reads the pointer at this+0x4 and proceeds to the cleanup callback only when it is non-null
When this+0x4 is non-null, calls the cdecl function pointer at offset 0x28 of the sub-object with this as its argument; the return value becomes result
Clears this+0x4 to 0 after the cleanup step
Clears this+0x10 to 0 after the cleanup step
Returns the callback return value if the sub-object existed, otherwise 0 (the value of this+0x4 when it was null)
